name: social-content-mcp
description: Brand kit in, on-brand posts and reels out.
long_description: Plans engagement posts from your brand kit and post history, builds the images in Penpot, renders 20-30 s reels and keeps a local log so nothing repeats. Bring your own Penpot MCP key, AI detector and (optionally) an Instagram token.

tools.name: init_brand_kit
tools.description: Create the brand kit folder layout

tools.name: plan_batch
tools.description: Plan a batch from the rotation and history

tools.name: render_reel
tools.description: Render a 20-30 s reel in one of 14 styles

tools.name: keeper_start
tools.description: Start the Penpot keeper and wait for it to connect

brand_kit_dir.title: Brand kit folder
brand_kit_dir.description: Folder with logo/, style/, assets/, voice/, brand.yaml and pillars.yaml. Run init_brand_kit to create it.

penpot_mcp_key.title: Penpot MCP key
penpot_mcp_key.description: Penpot: Your account > Integrations > MCP Server.

penpot_url.title: Penpot address
penpot_url.description: Only change this for a self-hosted Penpot.

instagram_token.title: Instagram Graph API token (optional)
instagram_token.description: Without it, the Insights step is skipped.

auto_keeper.title: Auto-start keeper
auto_keeper.description: Start the Penpot keeper with the extension, so Penpot's MCP plugin stays connected without running anything by hand.
